links.text:
Teenagers are spending as much time on social media as they would for a full-time job.

Girls are spending more than 35 hours a week on social media and boys are not far behind. If they keep this up, it means the average teenager will spend more than 10 years of their life doomscrolling.

This is why research on this topic is crucial. We still know very little about the long-term effects of this kind of exposure (most studies on the causal effects of social media are limited to a few weeks). https://www.oecd.org/en/publications/growing-up-in-the-social-media-age_a1132839-en/full-report.html?utm_term=pac&utm_medium=social&utm_content=2-InclusiveGrowth%2C1-StillImage%5BDataViz%5D%2CSummer%2C3-WISE&utm_source=linkedin

body: ببین رفیق، نوجونا جوری تو فضای مجازی قفل کردن که قد یه کار تمام‌وقت یعنی بالای ۳۵ ساعت در هفته وقت می‌ذارن. کارشناسا میگن اگه با همین فرمون برن بالای ۱۰ سال از عمرشون پای این داستانا میره و هنوز عوارض بلندمدتش درست معلوم نیست.
